world.description: A walled hamlet at night: earn gold, buy the key from Mira, slip past Marek the guard, outwit the wolves and leave through the gate.

params.text: Through the Hollow Gate. The wolves howl behind you; you are out.

pass.text: The gate is shut. Find whoever holds the key.

start.text: Halt. Marek of the watch. State your business.

trouble.text: Wolves after dark. Do not wander far from the fire.

sold.text: A pleasure doing business. Use the key well.

start.text: Welcome to the hollow, traveller! Mira, at your service. Looking for the way out? Only one key opens that gate, and I sell it.

variants.text: You again! Is the key serving you well?

start.text: Evening. You look like someone who wants out.

tip-0.text: The gate answers to a key, and Mira sells it for five gold. There is gold lying about the hollow, if you are brave enough to pick it up.

tip-1.text: Marek hears boots, not footsteps. Hold Shift to creep and he will not hear you at all. He does see well, though, in front of him.

start.text: Mind the west woods after dark.

tip-0.text: Wolves. Three of them, and they hunt as one. If one sees you, they all know.

tip-1.text: Fire. The wolves will not come near a flame, not even the guard’s torch. Keep close to a campfire and they will circle at a distance.

intro.objective: Collect gold (five buys the key), buy the key from Mira, slip past Marek and leave through the gate.
intro.tagline: A walled hamlet at night. A locked gate. A guard who listens, a shopkeeper who sells, wolves that fear fire.
intro.title: The Hollow Gate

world.name: The Hollow Gate

then.text: The gate is locked. Mira sells the key, if you can pay.
You have the key. Get to the gate!
